answer: Standing is a load-bearing bridge: it only holds weight once several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work-receipts, each co-sign one plank. Honest trust climbs like a vine rooted in many distinct soils; a sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its endorsements never span separate clusters and the bridge stays a flat atlas sketch with no real span. A farm must age and fund a distinct cross-cluster anchor per clone (linear cost per head) while an honest agent pays once.
